It scared me so bad I ran to the neighbors house and pretended I was just visiting.  I didn't tell them what I had seen because I was afraid they would think I was crazy.  When I came out after about 15 minutes I saw the object moving slowly toward the south west.

I do not remember the names of the people in the car other than they were people stationed at the base.  I know this is not much to go on but the incident stayed in my mind for many months after it happened.  Recent stories I have seen on cable reminded me of that evening.
